text_to_image_prompt: Premium refined semi-realistic 2.5D/3D character render, sculpted beautiful face, delicate skin microtexture and subsurface scattering, crisp eyes, fine individual hair strands, richly detailed fabric and metal physically based materials. Pure opaque white seamless studio background, bright soft neutral frontal light with fill, no colored cast, no text, no labels, no border, no watermark. Preserve CG material finish, not a photograph or flat illustration. An adult woman with long black loose waves and braids drawn back at both temples, violet eyes, pale neutral skin, softly tapered oval face and natural rose lips. Gray lace high collar and layered gray draped gown, floral shoulder ornaments and a silver cross necklace. Level chin, camera exactly at eye height, neither chin tucked nor camera looking down. Continue the gray draped gown into a continuous ankle-length flowing layered skirt, opaque gray underdress beneath sheer lace details, dark gray elegant flats. Tall 178 cm healthy slender build. Exactly nine head-and-shoulders portraits of this ONE SAME person in a clean 3 by 3 equal panel expression grid, every face front-facing eye-level same scale and consistent face hair clothes. Row1 neutral, gentle closed-mouth smile, happy open smile; row2 surprise mouth O, worried frown, quiet sadness; row3 focused anger, skeptical raised eyebrow, playful small wink. Expressions clearly distinct but attractive and natural. Full hair and shoulders inside each cell. Square overall canvas. Narrow white gutters, no text.
